title: Downloaded package files
why: Installers kept after installing; downloaded again if needed.

title: System journal older than 7 days
why: Archived journal files. journald is not running, so they are removed as files, as journalctl --vacuum-time=7d would.
command: remove archived journal files older than 7 days in /mnt/target/var/log/journal

title: Temporary files untouched for 7 days (1)
why: Files no program has changed in a week. The system is not running, so none is in use.

title: pip cache
why: Downloaded again on the next pip install.
command: remove the pip cache in every home folder

title: Old rotated logs (1 files)
why: Archived copies of logs. Keep them if an audit needs them.
